title: Semiconductor Fab Waste-Neutralization System Inspection Record
description: Evidence model for inspection and discharge-quality verification of acid/caustic waste neutralization systems treating semiconductor fab effluent before discharge to sewer. Fab processes (etch, clean, CMP) generate spent HF, HCl, H2SO4, NH4OH, and fluoride-bearing streams that must be neutralized to environmental compliance pH (typically 5.5-9.0) and fluoride limit (<15 mg/L under Korean wastewater regulations). Distinct from raw chemical (cleanroom-chemical-record) and exhaust-gas (scrubber-record) hazards: this evidence covers the liquid-effluent treatment train at the back end of the facility chemical lifecycle.

waste_stream.description: Effluent stream classification treated by this record's system

outlet_pH.description: Measured pH at system outlet after neutralization (compliance range typically 5.5-9.0)

reagent_dosing_verified.description: NaOH / H2SO4 / Ca(OH)2 dosing pump and control loop verified operational

fluoride_effluent_mg_per_L.description: Fluoride concentration in final discharge (Korean wastewater limit: 15 mg/L for semiconductor fabs); null if stream is non-fluoride

discharge_quality_within_limit.description: Final discharge pH, fluoride, and heavy metals all within Korean Water Environment Conservation Act limits

sensor_calibration_date.description: Last calibration date of pH and ion-selective sensors
